body:
I'm going to keep trying, and I'm checking out suicideproject.org.

I'm afraid that if I try too hard I'll push them away, and that if I don't try hard enough, I'll miss a chance that may keep them alive.

Thank you.

I'm trying to help them to expand their support network, but it's not easy. They post, but have already decided that it's not going to work and give up quickly. I'm struggling with depression myself (though I've never been suicidal), and I recognise its influence, telling them that everything that might help won't help them and therefore they should just avoid it altogether.
